ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white/light-grey surface (approx. 85%) with high-contrast low-intensity black perimeter and focal spots (approx. 15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black band along the entire trailing edge. Distinct black circular spots located: one in the mid-section of the left lobe, two small spots near the lower-left peduncle, a vertical cluster of three irregular spots in the center-lower region, and one larger irregular spot in the mid-section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 92 degrees and a depth roughly 15% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the span; left lobe displays more jagged, higher-amplitude peaks near the tip; right lobe displays relatively lower-amplitude, more uniform serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves originating from the median notch, tapering to pointed distal tips with a slight downward recurve at the extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity white, calcified material (barnacle colonizations) concentrated on the distal tips of both lobes and along the outermost leading edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast diagonal parallel lines (rake marks) visible on the upper-inner quadrant of the right lobe surface; single horizontal scratch visible on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular black pigmentation cluster at the base of the fluke near the peduncle junction; significant jagged notch on the outer-left trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical alignment of dark focal spots located along the central axis immediately below the median notch.
